The '''Tythos River Valley''' was a valley on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. The [[Tythos River]] ran through the valley, starting at the [[Forbidden Falls]] on the mountainside to the north, and ran south through the mountains past the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] and out to the [[Tythonian Gnarls]] and the [[Tythos River Delta]]. The valley was home to many [[horranth]]s.
